content.title: Roblox is using AI to address safety concerns, CEO explains
content.description:
Roblox (RBLX) has been at the center of child safety concerns, even facing lawsuits alleging an unsafe environment for underage users.

Roblox CEO Dave Baszucki joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss how the company is leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) to address safety concerns.
